group:paper-mock-shandong-liaocheng-jini.overview: 文章以 Sarah Jennings 买房前做房屋检查的经历开头，介绍房屋检查查什么、要花多少钱、需要多长时间，说明这笔花费能帮买房人避开错买和日后的高额维修。
group:paper-mock-shandong-liaocheng-jini.fullTranslationZh:
那是一套新房，售价15.4万美元。纽约州贝肖尔的萨拉·詹宁斯已经准备买下它，但她的房产经纪人建议先做一次房屋检查。几小时后，房屋检查员交给詹宁斯一份清单，上面列了20多个问题。詹宁斯说：“我当时真的很沮丧。这房子并不完美。”由于这些问题都不大，修起来也花不了多少钱，詹宁斯最后还是决定买下这套房子。

现在，许多人在买房过程中加上了房屋检查这一重要步骤。房屋检查员并不检查房价是否合理。相反，持证检查员检查的是房屋各方面的使用功能。水电是否运转正常？屋顶状况好不好？可能需要做哪些维修？

一次普通的房屋检查费用在200美元到500美元不等，全国平均价格在336美元左右。这看起来也许是一笔不必要的开支。然而，一次彻底的房屋检查能让你避免一次不明智的购买，还可能免去将来代价高昂的维修。换句话说，房屋检查费是为求安心而做的一笔投资。

房屋检查不是你想匆匆走过场的事。这是购房过程中重要的一步，能保障你这笔投资的价值。虽然检查一套房子要花多长时间并没有固定标准，但整个过程通常需要两到三个小时。附加设施多的房子检查时间会更长，而小房子可能只需一两个小时。

拥有自己住房的美国梦是可以实现的。不过，许多人仍未找到属于自己的住处。在贝肖尔，有2000多人想购买新住宅项目中的52套房子。其中至少有1948个家庭仍在找房。幸运的是，詹宁斯不在其中。

completedSourceTexts.text: It was a new home. It cost $154,000. Sarah Jennings of Bay Shore, New York was ready to buy it, but her real estate agent suggested getting a home inspection. Hours later, the home inspector gave Jennings a list of over 20 problems. Jennings said, “I was just depressed. It was less than perfect.” Since the problems were minor and would cost little to fix, Jennings decided to buy the house anyway.

Many people are now adding the important step of home inspection into the process of buying a home. A home inspector does not check to see if the price is reasonable. Instead, a certified one checks on all functional aspects of the house. Do the electricity and water work well? Is the roof in good condition? What repairs may be necessary?

A typical home inspection can cost anywhere from $200 to $500, with the national average sitting right around $336. This may seem like an unnecessary expense. However, a thorough home inspection can save you from an unwise purchase and possibly costly repairs in the future. Put another way, the home inspection fee is an investment in peace of mind.

A home inspection isn’t something you want to rush through. This is an important step in the home buying process and secures the value of your investment. While there are no set standards when it comes to the length of time it takes to inspect a home, the process usually takes about two to three hours. For homes with additional features, this process will take longer, while for small homes an inspection may only take an hour or two.

The American dream of owning a home is possible. Still, many have yet to find a place to call their own. In Bay Shore, there were more than 2,000 people interested in buying 52 houses in the new housing project. Among those, at least 1,948 families are still looking. Luckily, Jennings is not one of them.
